name: Daulat Securities Limited
about: Daulat Securities Limited provides stock broking services in India. The company engages in marketing mutual funds; and offers share broking and depositary services. It also provides various financial services, including equity and derivatives trading, depository services for secure holding and transfer of securities, margin trading, IPO investments, and mutual fund distribution activities; and research and advisory services, as well as risk management solutions. Daulat Securities Limited was incorporated in 1992 and is based in Kolkata, India.
